import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class FF {
        private long val;

        public FF(long v) {
            if (v < 0 || v > MOD) {
                System.err.println("Invalid value for FF");
                System.exit(1);
            }
            this.val = v;
        }

        public FF() {
            this.val = 0;
        }

        public long get() {
            return val;
        }

        public FF plus(FF o) {
            return new FF((this.val + o.val) % MOD);
        }

        public FF minus(FF o) {
            return new FF((this.val + MOD - o.val) % MOD);
        }

        public FF times(FF o) {
            return new FF((this.val * o.val) % MOD);
        }

        public FF divide(FF o) {
            FF inv = o.modInverse();
            return this.times(inv);
        }

        public FF modInverse() {
            // Fermat's little theorem for modular inverse
            return pow(MOD - 2);
        }

        public FF pow(long exp) {
            FF result = new FF(1);
            FF base = new FF(this.val);
            long p = exp;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.times(base);
                }
                base = base.times(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static <T> List<List<T>> make2D(int d1, int d2, T val) {
        List<List<T>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<T> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d2, val));
            res.add(row);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static <T> List<List<List<T>>> make3D(int d1, int d2, int d3, T val) {
        List<List<List<T>>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            res.add(make2D(d2, d3, val));
        }
        return res;
    }

    static <T> List<List<T>> mat_mult(List<List<T>> a, List<List<T>> b) {
        int n = a.size();
        int m = a.get(0).size();
        int l = b.get(0).size();
        List<List<T>> res = make2D(n, l, null);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                T sum = null;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    T valA = a.get(i).get(k);
                    T valB = b.get(k).get(j);
                    if (sum == null) {
                        sum = (T) valA;
                        if (sum instanceof FF) {
                            sum = (T) new FF(0);
                        }
                    }
                    if (sum instanceof FF && valA instanceof FF && valB instanceof FF) {
                        sum = (T) ((FF) sum).plus(((FF) valA).times((FF) valB));
                    }
                }
                res.get(i).set(j, sum);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static <T> List<T> mat_vec(List<List<T>> mat, List<T> v) {
        int n = mat.size();
        int m = v.size();
        List<T> res = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, null));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            T sum = null;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                T valM = mat.get(i).get(j);
                T valV = v.get(j);
                if (sum == null) {
                    sum = (T) valM;
                    if (sum instanceof FF) {
                        sum = (T) new FF(0);
                    }
                }
                if (sum instanceof FF && valM instanceof FF && valV instanceof FF) {
                    sum = (T) ((FF) sum).plus(((FF) valM).times((FF) valV));
                }
            }
            res.set(i, sum);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<List<List<FF>>> shifts = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FF(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts.get(k).get(i).set((i + k) % d, new FF(1));
            }
            shifts.get(k).get(d).set(d, new FF(1));
        }

        List<List<List<FF>>> units = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FF(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(i).set(i, new FF(1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(k).set(i, new FF(1));
            }
        }

        List<List<FF>> identity = make2D(d + 1, d + 1, new FF(0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            identity.get(i).set(i, new FF(1));
        }

        Map<Long, List<List<FF>>> cache = new HashMap<>();

        // Recursive function to get matrix
        class MatrixGetter {
            public List<List<FF>> getMatrix(long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                    return cache.get(p);
                }
                List<List<FF>> result;
                if (p <= d) {
                    result = make2D(d + 1, d + 1, new FF(0));
                    for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                        result.get(i).set(i, new FF(1));
                    }
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        result = mat_mult(units.get(k), result);
                    }
                    cache.put(p, result);
                    return result;
                }
                long child_p = d;
                while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) {
                    child_p *= d;
                }
                List<List<FF>> child = getMatrix(child_p);
                result = child;
                long rem = p - child_p;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                    if (rem >= child_p) {
                        result = mat_mult(shifts.get(d - k), result);
                        result = mat_mult(result, shifts.get(k));
                        result = mat_mult(result, child);
                        rem -= child_p;
                    } else if (rem > 0) {
                        List<List<FF>> rem_mat = getMatrix(rem);
                        result = mat_mult(shifts.get(d - k), result);
                        result = mat_mult(result, rem_mat);
                        result = mat_mult(result, shifts.get(k));
                        rem = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                cache.put(p, result);
                return result;
            }
        }

        MatrixGetter mg = new MatrixGetter();
        List<List<FF>> matrix = mg.getMatrix(n);
        List<FF> base_vec = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d + 1, new FF(0)));
        base_vec.set(d, new FF(1));
        List<FF> final_vec = mat_vec(matrix, base_vec);
        FF ans = new FF(0);
        for (FF v : final_vec) {
            ans = ans.plus(v);
        }
        System.out.println(ans.get());
    }
}
